title: FindIt
subtitle: Computer vision · embedded · UBC
summary: An embedded camera system that finds train-track defects with a custom Canny-style edge detector and a classifier for crack vs shelling candidates.

highlights.item: Custom Canny-style edge detection tuned for tracks
Associated with The University of British Columbia

intro.paragraph: FindIt (Sep 2020 – May 2021) is an embedded system with a camera that finds track defects using custom computer vision algorithms.
The vision stack recreates Canny edge detection tuned for train tracks. Detected candidates then go through a custom classifier that labels crack vs shelling defect types.

paragraphs.paragraph: Built with collaborators at UBC. The project sits at the intersection of embedded capture, classical CV, and practical defect triage for rail infrastructure.
Source and a walkthrough video are linked from this page.
